propositions: Compose immutable, non-secret operation snapshots containing validated effective values, explicit source-kind provenance, repository root, and envelope version across CLI, library, MCP, and direct reconciler entry points in shadow mode without altering current behavior.

Implement explicit composition precedence of operation input > environment > project config > user config > schema default, with repository root selected independently via explicit repo_root > REBAR_ROOT > Git top-level, and relative paths interpreted against the selected root.

Thread one snapshot through shared command seam, CLI, public library operations, MCP reads/writes/LLM tools, and direct reconciler in shadow mode while preserving existing execution as authoritative; shadow comparison emits only version, source kinds, and redacted fingerprint.
Guarantee snapshot fields, serialization, fingerprint, repr, and equality never contain live auth objects, secret wrappers/values, provider clients, source-file paths, or subprocess environments.

Enable REBAR_OPERATION_SNAPSHOT_SHADOW by default; when set to canonical false or any non-config shadow failure occurs, skip shadow construction and preserve legacy behavior without changing stored ticket/bridge formats.
